description: Implementation of the NoteService interface providing CRUD operations, partial updates, and listing functionalities for notes with filtering capabilities in a backend service.

classes.name: NoteServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class responsible for managing note entities.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note based on the provided request.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Converts all updatable fields of a note based on the request and saves.

methods.name: partialUpdate
methods.description: Updates only non-null fields of the note.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists notes with optional search keyword and tag filters, supporting pagination.
